name: MeshDash
description: Self-hosted Meshtastic mesh radio dashboard (GPL-3.0, Beta) -- this runner re-downloads and installs the latest MeshDash on every start so it needs internet access, runs standalone with no account by default (finish setup at /setup), and only contacts meshdash.co.uk's optional remote-access service if you set MD_SETUP_KEY below (off by default); defaults assume a TCP/Wi-Fi radio, add --privileged and a /dev mapping yourself for USB/Serial.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database (SQLite), logs, plugin data, and the settings file written by the /setup wizard -- persists across the runner's automatic MeshDash version updates. Mounted as a folder, not a file mapping. The image always runs as root with no PUID/PGID support (verified in docker/runner/Dockerfile), so no ownership fix-up is needed or possible.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: MeshDash's web dashboard and /setup wizard. Verified against the runner's entrypoint.sh (28 Sep 2026): defaults to port 8000 unless WEBSERVER_PORT is set. Note: rusjpmd/meshdash-runner's own Docker Hub description claims R3.1+ moved the default to 8181, which contradicts the entrypoint script actually shipped in the current :latest image -- if the WebUI doesn't respond after first boot, check docker logs for the 'Starting MeshDash on port' line and adjust this mapping (and WEBSERVER_PORT below) to match.

variables.name: WEBSERVER_PORT
variables.description: Overrides the port MeshDash listens on inside the container -- see the WebUI port note above about the 8000 vs 8181 discrepancy. Change this and the WebUI port mapping together.

variables.name: MD_SETUP_KEY
variables.description: Only needed to opt into meshdash.co.uk's cloud C2 setup/remote-management service. Leave blank (default) to run fully standalone with no account -- everything is configured locally via the /setup wizard instead. Setting this alone does nothing: the runner also requires an MD_SETUP_URL variable (deliberately not included in this template) before it will contact meshdash.co.uk for C2 provisioning -- add both yourself via 'Add another Path, Port, Variable...' if you want that feature.
